behavior: Backtest plan identity now binds dataset manifest, policy registration, evaluator code, factor bundle, Regime version, execution assumptions and cost model; selection authorization additionally requires its own receipt hash.
Every replay date requires a hash-bound PIT universe receipt tied to plan/run/date/decision clock, registry identity and exact membership hashes.
Future membership-end fields are excluded from the strategy-visible PIT universe contract.
Resume checkpoints are hash-recomputed before any loader/evaluator and reconciled to requested dates, date summaries, partition receipts, sample counts, state counts and rolling digest.
Partition receipts bind exact sample hashes into the rolling digest.
Zero-sample completion is rejected unless the PIT universe is explicitly and immutably proved empty.
AP-04 forged completed checkpoint is rejected before any universe loader or evaluator executes.
